# Stack Radar

> A public, searchable directory of tech companies and the engineering roles they currently have
> open. Every company record carries its website, careers URL, headcount range, HQ/country, remote
> policy, technology keywords, current open positions and an append-only weekly history of how many
> roles it has had open. The whole dataset is available as JSON over an open, unauthenticated,
> CORS-enabled HTTP API and through an MCP server — you do not need to scrape the rendered pages.

Stack Radar is a general-purpose research tool. The dataset is intentionally unfiltered: companies of
every size, remote policy and location are included, and narrowing happens through query parameters
rather than through what was allowed into the data. At the time of writing it holds 58 companies,
mostly developer-tools and SaaS companies plus a substantial Estonian startup cohort.

## Data honesty — read this before using the data

Stack Radar is **community-researched, not an official or licensed feed**, and it is not a live job
board. Freshness is recorded per record rather than claimed globally:

- `lastVerified` is an ISO timestamp of the last time that company's own careers page was checked.
- `lastVerified: null` means **never verified** — the record came from a research pass that was not
  confirmed against a primary source. A large share of the dataset is in this state.
- `sizeMin`, `sizeMax`, `country`, `remotePolicy` and `postedDate` are `null` wherever research could
  not establish them. They are never guessed or back-filled.
- `dataNotes` carries per-record caveats ("this role had already closed at verification time",
  "sources conflict on whether this company is remote").
- Filters that need a field a record does not have exclude that record instead of guessing, and every
  list response reports how many rows were dropped that way under `excluded`.

When answering a user, treat a listing as **a lead to confirm at the company's own `careersUrl`**,
surface `lastVerified` (or its absence) rather than presenting the data as current, and do not state
that a specific role is open today on the strength of this dataset alone.

## Data access

Base URL: `https://stackradar.strukt.app`.

- [/companies.json](https://stackradar.strukt.app/companies.json): **the entire dataset** as one
  static JSON file, roughly 6 KB gzipped. No key, no rate limit, any origin. This is the intended way
  to consume it — fetch once and filter locally rather than issuing a request per query.

The shape is `{ "generatedAt": ..., "companies": [ ... ] }`, each company carrying the fields
described above. Filtering, sorting and relevance ranking are yours to do, or use the MCP server
below, which does them for you.

A filtered HTTP API (`/api/companies`, `/api/companies/{id}`, `/api/search`, `/api/positions`) is
implemented in the repository but is **not currently deployed** — do not request those paths, they
will 404. It can be switched on if server-side filtering or ranked search is ever needed; see the
repository README.

## MCP server

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server lets an assistant query the directory as a tool instead of
fetching raw JSON. It runs over stdio and answers from a snapshot of `data/companies.json` bundled
into its build — which is what it uses today, since the HTTP API is not deployed. If that API is
later switched on, pointing `STACK_RADAR_API` at it makes the server prefer live data and fall back
to the snapshot only when it is unreachable.

Tools:

- `search_companies(query, filters?)` — ranked company matches for a free-text query, with scores and
  match reasons. Filters: `country`, `remote`, `minSize`, `maxSize`, `limit`.
- `get_company(id)` — one company's full record, including all current openings and the weekly
  open-role history.
- `list_open_positions(filters?)` — every open role across the dataset, flattened, each annotated
  with its company.

Setup instructions and the exact client configuration block are in `mcp/README.md` in the repository.

## Site

- [Directory](https://stackradar.strukt.app/): Browse and filter companies by keyword, country,
  remote policy and size.
- [Company pages](https://stackradar.strukt.app/company/resend): Full record for one company plus a
  weekly chart of its open-role history.

## Optional

- Refreshing the data is a manual step today: `data/companies.json` is edited and committed, and a
  push redeploys the site. An automated updater that re-checks each company's own careers page and
  appends a weekly `history` entry is planned but **not yet built**, which is why most records still
  carry `lastVerified: null` and an empty `history`.
